name: ninerlog-website
description: NinerLog.com — The free, open-source pilot logbook website

scripts.build: npm run build:njk && npm run build:css && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: cp -r images _site/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp favicon.svg favicon.ico apple-touch-icon.png robots.txt sitemap.xml CNAME _site/ 2>/dev/null || true
